# Button

Starts an action: sending a form, enrolling, moving to the next step. Gold primary, soft and outline variants, at least 44 px tall.

```tsx
import { Button } from '@kafka-ds/react'
```

## When to use it

- For the one action you most want the reader to take (primary), and for secondary actions next to it (soft, outline).
- For actions that happen on the page or submit a form. If it only navigates somewhere else, use a link.

## When not to

- More than one primary button in a view: when everything is loud, nothing is.
- As a link. Navigation is `<a>`; a button that changes the URL breaks the back button and "open in a new tab".
- Gold text on paper. The gold is a surface for the primary button (with ink text, 8.3:1), never a text colour on paper (1.98:1).

## Examples

### Variants

Use one primary button per view; soft and outline are for secondary actions.

```tsx
<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
  <Button>Inscribirme</Button>
  <Button variant="soft">Ver programa</Button>
  <Button variant="outline">Más información</Button>
</div>
```

### With icons

A leading icon names the action; a trailing arrow suggests moving forward; both can go together.

```tsx
<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
  <Button Icon={IconCrown}>Hazte miembro</Button>
  <Button variant="outline" TrailingIcon={IconArrowRight}>Continuar</Button>
  <Button variant="soft" Icon={IconCrown} TrailingIcon={IconArrowRight}>Ver membresías</Button>
</div>
```

### Link variant

Text only and always underlined, for a quiet action that runs on the page. It is still 44 px tall. For navigation use a Link.

```tsx
<Button variant="link">Ver el reglamento</Button>
```

### Disabled and loading

Loading keeps the label, shows a spinner and announces the busy state. Disabled buttons stay out of the tab order.

```tsx
<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
  <Button disabled>No disponible</Button>
  <Button variant="soft" disabled>No disponible</Button>
  <Button variant="outline" disabled>No disponible</Button>
  <Button loading>Enviando</Button>
</div>
```

### Full width

On small screens a primary action can span the width of its container.

```tsx
<div className="w-full max-w-sm">
  <Button block>Pagar ahora</Button>
</div>
```

### On the VIP card

The `vip` variant is fixed ink in both modes, because the gold of the VIP card does not change either. Use it only inside that card.

```tsx
<Card highlight="vip" className="max-w-xs">
  <Button variant="vip" block>Hacerme miembro</Button>
</Card>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `ButtonVariant` | `'primary'` | How loud the button is. `primary` is the gold call to action; use one per view. |
| `Icon` | `IconType` |  | Icon before the label (any Phosphor icon component). |
| `TrailingIcon` | `IconType` |  | Icon after the label, for example an arrow that moves forward. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a spinner, disables the button and sets `aria-busy`. The label stays visible. |
| `block` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretches the button to the full width of its container. |
| …rest | `ComponentPropsWithRef<'button'>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **Native `<button>`.** Enter and Space activate it; `type="button"` by default so it never submits a form by accident.
- **Focus ring** on keyboard focus only: a 3 px solid outline, offset 2 px, from the `focus.*` tokens (3:1 against both page and surface).
- **Target size** of at least 44 px tall, above the 24 px WCAG 2.5.8 minimum.
- **Contrast** of every label, in every state and in both modes, is checked by `tests/contrast.mjs` (primary 8.3:1).
- **Disabled** buttons leave the tab order and drop to `opacity.disabled` (0.45). Do not use disabled to explain why something is unavailable: say it in text.
- **Loading** sets `aria-busy`, disables the button and appends a visually hidden "Loading" (localised through `KafkaProvider`). The label stays visible so the layout does not jump.
- **Icons** are decorative: they are `aria-hidden`, and the label carries the meaning.
- **Reduced motion:** the spinner slows down under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## Content

- Start with a verb: "Inscribirme", "Enviar relato", "Ver programa". Avoid "Aceptar" and "Click aquí".
- Keep it to one to three words; the surrounding text explains the rest.
- In Spanish, prefer the first person for commitments ("Inscribirme") and the imperative for neutral actions ("Ver programa").
